row.proto: float Ai_Get_SegmentTurnRadius(void *ai, float dist, uint32_t node_idx, float lateral_offset, int route_idx)
row.notes: was Ai_Get_SegmentSpeedLimit (renamed 2026-11-16: the value is a signed turn radius, not a speed limit). node = lane4 node [[[[ai+0x4f8]+0x78][route_idx]+0x58]+0x18][node_idx]; link = node+8, from gate = link+0x10, to gate = link+0x18. Per gate: v = node +0xbc of the out link ([gate+0x60+route*8]+0x40) and of the in link ([gate+0x70+route*8]+0x40), default 1e38; keeps whichever of (v - lateral_offset) has the smaller magnitude, clamped to +-500. Node +0xb8/+0xbc are written by Game_AiRoute_BuildGraph (0x14067e075/0x14067e07e): the parameters where the two averaged horizontal normals of the node (0.5*(n_in+n_chord) at P0, 0.5*(n_chord+n_out) at P1) intersect, i.e. the signed distance to the centre of curvature (turn radius, sign = turn side); FLT_MAX when |2D cross| < FLT_EPSILON. t = clamp((dist - node+0xb4)/node+0xc0, 0, 1). Same sign: a + (b-a)*t. Opposite signs: the radius passes through +-500 (straight) at t0 = |a|/(|a|+|b|), exactly 500.0 at t0. Missing node or gates -> 500.0. Callers take the absolute value (Ai_Get_TurnRadiusAtDistance, Ai_Get_TurnRadiusOnOwnRoute) or the signed value (Ai_Get_SignedTurnRadiusOnOwnRoute); Ai_Job_UpdateCarsParallel stores three results at record +0x164/+0x168/+0x16c.
